Segment 6: The Sanskrit/Hindi string 'एते मात्रा स्पर्शाः, शीतोष्ण सुख-दुःखदाः' was left as in the transcript. Its exact intended Sanskritization is unclear; please review against audio or source text.

Segment 8: Sanskrit corrections (the verse and 'सुधांशु') were applied with medium confidence; please review against the original spoken verse or source if precise canonical wording is required.

Segment 8: Left other Sanskrit/Sanskritized phrases (e.g., 'सुधा रूपी अंशवः', 'बहुब्रीहि समास') largely as in the raw transcript where exact restoration was uncertain, to avoid introducing doctrinal changes.
Segment 9: Medium-confidence corrections: 'महर्षिकार बोलते हैं' → 'महर्षि कहते हैं' (ASR likely misrecognition); please verify against audio.
Segment 9: 'चेहरा...' → 'वो' was inferred as a filler misrecognition; check original audio for exact filler/word.
Segment 9: English sentence corrected to 'This is one of the biggest declarations.' — verify speaker's exact wording if a different nuance was intended.
Segment 11: Sanskrit fragment 'अविद्यमानत्वे सति भासमानत्व।' is left as in source because intended exact wording is uncertain; please verify against the speaker's original or canonical text.
Segment 11: Phrase 'न पुला-बुला करके' (appears as 'न पुला-बुला करके' in the transcript) seems odd/uncertain in sense; left unchanged — please review the intended colloquialism or word.
